ch_es3ba.title: Berserker Serum
ch_es3ba.description: +4 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. All limiters removed. Pain is irrelevant. Only killing matters.

ch_es3bb.title: Apex Predator Formula
ch_es3bb.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.4 Attack Speed, +2 Max Health. The ultimate combat enhancement. Nothing survives your onslaught.

ch_ft1.title: Fortitude
ch_ft1.description: +3 Max Health. Your body is accustomed to toxins. What kills others barely registers in your bloodstream.

ch_ft2a.title: Antibodies
ch_ft2a.description: +4 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Your immune system is overclocked. Nothing foreign survives in you.

ch_ft2b.title: Mutagen
ch_ft2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed, +1 Attack Damage. Self-experimentation. The mutations are... mostly beneficial.

ch_ft3aa.title: Chemical Immunity
ch_ft3aa.description: +6 Max Health. Total biological resistance. Your cells reject all foreign agents  -  spore included.

ch_ft3ab.title: Hardened Cells
ch_ft3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Cell walls reinforced through exposure. You're harder to damage than concrete.

ch_ft3ba.title: Adaptive Mutation
ch_ft3ba.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Your mutations keep evolving. Faster, stronger, more lethal each day.

ch_ft3bb.title: Transcendence
ch_ft3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +1 Attack Damage, +0.008 Movement Speed. Beyond human chemistry. You've rewritten your own biology.

ch_ls1.title: Lab Safety
ch_ls1.description: +4 Max Health. Hazmat protocols burned into muscle memory. You survive your own experiments.

ch_ls2a.title: Hazmat Rated
ch_ls2a.description: +5 Max Health. Full chemical protection. Your body is sealed against splash damage  -  your own and theirs.

ch_ls2b.title: Chemical Resistance
ch_ls2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Your body adapted to toxins. Hits that should corrode you just bounce off.

ch_ls3aa.title: Contamination Proof
ch_ls3aa.description: +7 Max Health. Nothing toxic touches you. You walk through clouds of death like they're morning mist.

ch_ls3ab.title: Reinforced Suit
ch_ls3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Military-grade protection with chemical lining. Tough inside AND out.

ch_ls3ba.title: Toxin Immunity
ch_ls3ba.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Your cells are immune to everything. The spore itself can't latch onto your biology.

ch_ls3bb.title: Walking Biohazard
ch_ls3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +1 Attack Damage. YOU are the contamination. Everything near you suffers.

ch_mb1.title: Light Feet
ch_mb1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Quick and quiet. You move between workstations and killzones with equal efficiency.

ch_mb2a.title: Stimulant
ch_mb2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Self-administered performance enhancers. The side effects are worth the speed.

ch_mb2b.title: Chemical Rush
ch_mb2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Adrenaline cocktail. Faster AND stronger  -  temporarily permanent.

ch_mb3aa.title: Overdrive
ch_mb3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Maximum chemical enhancement. Your nervous system fires at superhuman frequency.

ch_mb3ab.title: Combat Stims
ch_mb3ab.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Field-tested combat drugs. Side effect: everything around you dies.

ch_mb3ba.title: Toxic Cloud Runner
ch_mb3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. Leave a trail of death wherever you sprint. Motion disperses your chemicals.

ch_mb3bb.title: Methane Sprint
ch_mb3bb.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +1 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. Volatile and fast. You ARE a chemical weapon in transit.

ch_pd1.title: Plague Doctor
ch_pd1.description: +1 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. Knowledge of disease is knowledge of death. Both serve you equally.

ch_pd2a.title: Epidemic
ch_pd2a.description: +2 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. Your strikes spread infection through the horde. One cut, many casualties.

ch_pd2b.title: Quarantine
ch_pd2b.description: +3 Max Health, +2 Luck. Isolate the threat, study it, exploit it. Knowledge protects and enriches.

ch_pd3aa.title: Pandemic
ch_pd3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. Weaponized plague. Your chemicals cascade through connected organisms, destroying everything.

ch_pd3ab.title: Contagion Master
ch_pd3ab.description: +2 Attack Damage, +2 Luck. Every kill yields samples. Every sample improves your next formula.

ch_pd3ba.title: Specimen Collector
ch_pd3ba.description: +3 Luck. Rare compounds from rare creatures. The more exotic the kill, the better your reagents.

ch_pd3bb.title: Patient Zero
ch_pd3bb.description: +3 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. You are the origin point of something terrible. Everything radiating from you decays.

ch_tx1.title: Reactive Agent
ch_tx1.description: +2 Attack Damage. Your blade is coated in something foul. Every cut burns worse than it should.

ch_tx2a.title: Concentrated Dose
ch_tx2a.description: +3 Attack Damage. Triple-distilled venom. A single drop eats through flesh like acid through paper.

ch_tx2b.title: Slow Burn
ch_tx2b.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Fast application, slow death. They don't realize they're dead for seconds.

ch_tx3aa.title: Lethal Injection
ch_tx3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. One precise dose of pure death. Injected directly where it hurts most.

ch_tx3ab.title: Necrotic Wound
ch_tx3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. Wounds that refuse to close. The infected rot faster where your blade touches.

ch_tx3ba.title: Rapid Application
ch_tx3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Apply toxins faster than they can react. Coat, cut, coat, cut  -  machine-like efficiency.

ch_tx3bb.title: Catalyst
ch_tx3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.4 Attack Speed. Each strike accelerates the reaction. Faster and more lethal with every swing.

ch_vc1.title: Volatile Compounds
ch_vc1.description: +0.3 Attack Speed. Unstable mixtures in your veins. They make you jittery  -  and deadly fast.

ch_vc2a.title: Chain Reaction
ch_vc2a.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. One strike triggers a cascade. Your chemistry amplifies each subsequent blow.

ch_vc2b.title: Measured Pour
ch_vc2b.description: +0.2 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Precision dosing. Not faster  -  more effective per application.

ch_vc3aa.title: Exothermic
ch_vc3aa.description: +0.7 Attack Speed. Your compounds generate heat on contact. The reaction is violent and instant.

ch_vc3ab.title: Combustion
ch_vc3ab.description: +0.4 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Strikes that ignite on impact. Chemistry weaponized to its purest form.

ch_vc3ba.title: Potent Formula
ch_vc3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. Raw chemical power condensed into every strike. Maximum payload per hit.

ch_vc3bb.title: Unstable Genius
ch_vc3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed, +1 Luck. Chaotic brilliance. Your mixtures shouldn't work  -  but they do.

class_root.title: Choose Your Path
class_root.description: Select a specialization. This choice is permanent.

g_a1.title: Quick Scope
g_a1.description: Snap to sights in a heartbeat. When infected burst through doorways, you're already aimed.

g_a2a.title: Dead Eye
g_a2a.description: Down the sights, everything sharpens. Your focused aim turns each bullet into a scalpel.

g_a2b.title: Hip Fire Pro
g_a2b.description: Who needs sights? Point shooting perfected  -  your barrel IS your crosshair.

g_a3aa.title: Marksman Elite
g_a3aa.description: Devastating precision while scoped. Every ADS shot carries the weight of a sniper round  -  methodical, lethal.

g_a3ab.title: Scope Stability
g_a3ab.description: Rock-steady aim down sights. Enhanced ADS damage paired with pinpoint scope accuracy.

g_a3ba.title: Spray Master
g_a3ba.description: Controlled chaos from the hip. Your unaimed fire tears through clusters of infected like a buzzsaw.

g_a3bb.title: Point Blank Specialist
g_a3bb.description: Devastating at close range without sights. Hip fire damage boosted with tighter spread for CQB dominance.

g_cap1.title: Operator
g_cap1.description: +8% Gun Damage, +3 Max Health. Full kit, full training, full lethality. A complete firearms platform.

g_cap2a.title: Elite Marksman
g_cap2a.description: +12% Gun Damage, +4 Max Health. Top-tier operator. Every shot surgical, every engagement won.

g_cap2b.title: Battle Hardened
g_cap2b.description: +8% Gun Damage, +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Seasoned warrior. Fast, lethal, nearly unkillable.

g_cap3aa.title: God of Guns
g_cap3aa.description: +18% Gun Damage, +4 Max Health. The ultimate marksman. Every bullet finds its mark. Every shot ends a threat.

g_cap3ab.title: Deadeye Legend
g_cap3ab.description: +15% Gun Damage, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Immovable. Unerring. The last thing they see is your muzzle flash.

g_cap3ba.title: Bullet Storm
g_cap3ba.description: +12% Gun Damage, +0.015 Movement Speed. Run and gun perfected. A mobile storm of lead and precision.

g_cap3bb.title: One Man Army
g_cap3bb.description: +10% Gun Damage, +5 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. The apex gunner. Firepower, survivability, mobility. Everything.

g_e1.title: Endurance
g_e1.description: +3 Max Health. Long patrols toughened your body. You outlast your ammunition.

g_e2a.title: Iron Lungs
g_e2a.description: +5 Max Health. You can hold position for hours. Deep breathing keeps you alive and aimed.

g_e2b.title: Combat Fitness
g_e2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Run and gun conditioning. Tough enough to stand, fast enough to reposition.

g_e3aa.title: Bulletproof
g_e3aa.description: +7 Max Health. You've taken so many hits your body stopped noticing. Pain is just data.

g_e3ab.title: Marathon Shooter
g_e3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Endurance for the long fight. Sprint to cover, stay alive, keep firing.

g_e3ba.title: Quick Feet
g_e3ba.description: +0.012 Movement Speed. Fast repositioning. Never stay in one place long enough to get swarmed.

g_e3bb.title: War Veteran
g_e3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Years of combat forged an unstoppable soldier. Tough, fast, experienced.

g_h1.title: Weak Spot
g_h1.description: You've studied the infected long enough to know where skull meets spine. Aim there.

g_h2a.title: Execution
g_h2a.description: One clean shot to the temple. The lights go out before they even know you're there.

g_h2b.title: Crippling Shot
g_h2b.description: Aim for the brainstem  -  disable motor function. They drop whether you kill them or not.

g_h3aa.title: One Tap
g_h3aa.description: A single bullet. A single kill. Your headshots delete threats from existence  -  no second chances needed.

g_h3ab.title: Cranial Cascade
g_h3ab.description: Headshots that pierce through to the next skull in line. Pop one head, damage the one behind it.

g_h3ba.title: Surgical Precision
g_h3ba.description: Impossible accuracy under pressure. Even sprinting through a horde, your crosshair finds the kill zone.

g_h3bb.title: Nerve Shredder
g_h3bb.description: Your headshots scramble the nervous system. Devastating cranial damage combined with raw stopping force.

g_m1.title: Combat Roll
g_m1.description: Stay mobile, stay alive. You've learned to shoot accurately even while repositioning.

g_m2a.title: Run & Gun
g_m2a.description: Full sprint, full accuracy. The dead can't catch what they can't corner.

g_m2b.title: Low Profile
g_m2b.description: Light on your feet. Move like a whisper through the ruins  -  faster, quieter, deadlier.

g_m3aa.title: Sprint Fire
g_m3aa.description: Full-bore sprinting with pinpoint accuracy. You're a moving fortress  -  impossible to pin down, impossible to outrun.

g_m3ab.title: Hip Fire Dancer
g_m3ab.description: Mobile warfare perfected. Dodge and weave while laying down accurate hip fire  -  a nightmare to pin down.

g_m3ba.title: Ghost Step
g_m3ba.description: Silent and swift as a phantom. Raw speed that lets you outpace even sprinting infected.

g_m3bb.title: Tactical Athlete
g_m3bb.description: Peak physical conditioning. Faster legs AND better weapon handling on the move  -  the complete package.

g_p1.title: Steady Aim
g_p1.description: Breathe slow. Squeeze, don't pull. Every bullet counts when the dead are at your door.

g_p2a.title: Hollow Points
g_p2a.description: Expanding rounds that tear through rotting flesh. Maximum tissue damage on soft targets.

g_p2b.title: FMJ Rounds
g_p2b.description: Full metal jacket. Punches clean through bone and armor  -  line them up and drop two with one trigger pull.

g_p3aa.title: Stopping Power
g_p3aa.description: Each round hits like a sledgehammer. Even the biggest infected stumble backwards when you land a center-mass shot.

g_p3ab.title: Brutal Impact
g_p3ab.description: Your rounds cave in ribcages. Massive knockback sends the horde tumbling over each other.

g_p3ba.title: Penetrator
g_p3ba.description: Tungsten-core rounds that ignore cover entirely. Shoot through walls, doors, and the infected hiding behind them.

g_p3bb.title: Armor Shredder
g_p3bb.description: Specialized AP rounds that strip away protection. Pierce through AND deal bonus damage to armored threats.

g_r1.title: Recoil Control
g_r1.description: Muscle memory from countless firefights. Your wrists absorb shock like pistons.

g_r2a.title: Iron Wrists
g_r2a.description: Your forearms are like steel cables. Full-auto feels like semi-auto used to.

g_r2b.title: Compensator Mind
g_r2b.description: You instinctively counter muzzle climb. Vertical kick becomes a gentle nudge.

g_r3aa.title: Dead Steady
g_r3aa.description: Absolute stillness under fire. Your muzzle barely twitches  -  even during sustained automatic bursts at the horde.

g_r3ab.title: Spray Surgeon
g_r3ab.description: Less kick means more hits. Your controlled recoil translates directly into higher effective DPS.

g_r3ba.title: Zero Drift
g_r3ba.description: Horizontal sway eliminated. Your crosshair tracks in a perfect vertical line  -  no lateral jitter whatsoever.

g_r3bb.title: Laser Beam
g_r3bb.description: Both axes locked down. Your gun climbs predictably  -  zero horizontal AND reduced vertical. Pure beam accuracy.

g_rl1.title: Speed Loader
g_rl1.description: Muscle memory kicks in. Mag changes are second nature  -  you barely think about it anymore.

g_rl2a.title: Tactical Reload
g_rl2a.description: Combat reload perfected. Drop mag, seat fresh one, rack  -  all in one fluid motion while moving.

g_rl2b.title: Extended Mags
g_rl2b.description: Jury-rigged extensions welded onto standard magazines. More rounds before you're caught empty.

g_rl3aa.title: Lightning Hands
g_rl3aa.description: Blink and you'll miss it. Your reload is so fast the infected never get a free lunge window.

g_rl3ab.title: Bolt Mastery
g_rl3ab.description: Chamber a fresh round instantly. Bolt-actions and pump-actions cycle like semi-autos in your hands.

g_rl3ba.title: Drum Mags
g_rl3ba.description: Salvaged drum magazines from a military convoy. Hold a staggering amount of rounds  -  spray all day.

g_rl3bb.title: Bottomless Belt
g_rl3bb.description: Extended capacity AND ammo conservation. Each mag lasts an eternity  -  the horde runs out before your bullets do.

g_s1.title: Stability
g_s1.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Planted like a turret. Nothing moves you off your firing position.

g_s2a.title: Iron Stance
g_s2a.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Recoil? What recoil? Your body absorbs everything. Steady as bedrock.

g_s2b.title: Braced Position
g_s2b.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +3 Max Health. Lock in and hold. The horde breaks against you like waves.

g_s3aa.title: Immovable Gunner
g_s3aa.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. They push, you shoot. They push harder, you shoot more. Simple physics.

g_s3ab.title: Living Turret
g_s3ab.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +3 Max Health. A fortified firing platform made of flesh and determination.

g_s3ba.title: Deep Roots
g_s3ba.description: +4 Max Health. Your body is dense and grounded. Nothing pulls you from your shooting position.

g_s3bb.title: Fortress Gunner
g_s3bb.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +4 Max Health. Part bunker, part marksman. They'll never breach your position.

g_v1.title: Bulletproof Vest
g_v1.description: Scavenged Kevlar stitched into your jacket. Won't stop a tank round, but infected claws? Easy.

g_v2a.title: Trauma Plates
g_v2a.description: Ceramic inserts over vital organs. You can take hits that would drop most survivors.

g_v2b.title: Adrenaline Rush
g_v2b.description: Pain fuels your combat high. Your body floods with chemicals that keep you moving when others fold.

g_v3aa.title: Walking Tank
g_v3aa.description: Maximum protection. Layered armor plating makes you an immovable object  -  the horde breaks against you.

g_v3ab.title: Juggernaut
g_v3ab.description: Unstoppable mass. Raw HP combined with knockback immunity  -  nothing moves you from your position.

g_v3ba.title: Combat Stim
g_v3ba.description: Military-grade stimulants. Enhanced vitality AND reflexes  -  your body operates beyond normal limits.

g_v3bb.title: Berserker Serum
g_v3bb.description: Experimental combat drugs. More health, more speed, AND your guns hit harder. Side effects? Who cares anymore.

gh_bw1.title: Blade Work
gh_bw1.description: +0.3 Attack Speed. You've honed your dagger technique on a thousand shambling targets.

gh_bw2a.title: Twin Fangs
gh_bw2a.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Two blades, two cuts, one heartbeat. Dual wielding perfected through apocalypse.

gh_bw2b.title: Serrated Edge
gh_bw2b.description: +0.2 Attack Speed, +2 Attack Damage. A jagged blade that tears on the way out. Maximum damage per cut.

gh_bw3aa.title: Scissor Strike
gh_bw3aa.description: +0.8 Attack Speed. Blades cross and uncross in a blur. Heads separate from shoulders before bodies fall.

gh_bw3ab.title: Viper Flurry
gh_bw3ab.description: +0.6 Attack Speed, +1 Attack Damage. Fast as a snake's tongue  -  each strike venomous and precise.

gh_bw3ba.title: Hemorrhage
gh_bw3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. One deep cut in the right place. The infected don't bleed out but they sure fall apart.

gh_bw3bb.title: Death of a Thousand Cuts
gh_bw3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.4 Attack Speed. Fast, sharp, relentless. They decompose faster than they regenerate.

gh_cap1.title: Wraith Initiate
gh_cap1.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.2 Attack Speed. You've begun the transformation. More spirit than flesh, more death than life.

gh_cap2a.title: Spectral Fury
gh_cap2a.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Strike with the rage of the unquiet dead. Fast, vicious, relentless.

gh_cap2b.title: Ethereal Form
gh_cap2b.description: +4 Max Health, +0.008 Movement Speed. Your body phases between states. Hard to hit what's barely corporeal.

gh_cap3aa.title: Wraith Lord
gh_cap3aa.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.5 Attack Speed. The ultimate ghost  -  all speed, all lethality, no mercy. A king of shadows.

gh_cap3ab.title: Doom Blade
gh_cap3ab.description: +4 Attack Damage, +0.2 Attack Speed. Your weapon pulses with killing intent. Each swing reaps like a scythe through wheat.

gh_cap3ba.title: Specter's Endurance
gh_cap3ba.description: +6 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. An undying wraith. Fast, resilient, eternal. The apocalypse made flesh.

gh_cap3bb.title: Ascended Wraith
gh_cap3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Transcended mortality entirely. A god of shadow and silence.

gh_ev1.title: Evasion
gh_ev1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Dodge, duck, weave. You flow around attacks like water around stone.

gh_ev2a.title: Slip Away
gh_ev2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Grabbing hands close on empty air. You were there a moment ago  -  now you're not.

gh_ev2b.title: Deflect
gh_ev2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Redirect force rather than absorb it. An aikido of the apocalypse.

gh_ev3aa.title: Untouchable
gh_ev3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. They swing, you're gone. A phantom that exists between moments of violence.

gh_ev3ab.title: Ghost Step
gh_ev3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Move like you're already dead  -  weightless, formless, unkillable.

gh_ev3ba.title: Iron Mist
gh_ev3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. You absorb impacts like fog absorbs light  -  present but immovable.

gh_ev3bb.title: Phase Shift
gh_ev3bb.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +0.01 Movement Speed. Exist partially in another place. Hits pass through you like you're not quite real.

gh_lf1.title: Lightfoot
gh_lf1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Your footfalls are whispers. You cross rubble fields without disturbing a single pebble.

gh_lf2a.title: Cat's Grace
gh_lf2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Land from any height without sound. Move through any space without trace.

gh_lf2b.title: Silent Approach
gh_lf2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +2 Attack Damage. Get close without being detected. The first hit is always free.

gh_lf3aa.title: Featherweight
gh_lf3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. You weigh nothing. Snow doesn't crunch, leaves don't rustle, floorboards don't creak.

gh_lf3ab.title: Shadow Walker
gh_lf3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Walk between worlds  -  half in shadow, half in flesh. Barely there but very much alive.

gh_lf3ba.title: Backstab
gh_lf3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. Approach unseen, strike unblocked. The perfect kill  -  clean, quiet, efficient.

gh_lf3bb.title: Shadow Assassin
gh_lf3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.01 Movement Speed. Silent death walking. You were never here  -  only the bodies prove otherwise.

gh_ph1.title: Predator Hunt
gh_ph1.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.005 Movement Speed. You stalk the dead like prey. The hunter becomes the apex.

gh_ph2a.title: Stalker's Patience
gh_ph2a.description: +2 Attack Damage. Wait for the perfect moment. One strike, one kill, zero wasted effort.

gh_ph2b.title: Chase Down
gh_ph2b.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Once you lock on, nothing escapes. You run prey to ground like a wolf.

gh_ph3aa.title: Assassin's Mark
gh_ph3aa.description: +3 Attack Damage. You see weak points others miss  -  joints, fractures, exposed vertebrae. Every hit is critical.

gh_ph3ab.title: Kill Confirmed
gh_ph3ab.description: +2 Attack Damage, +2 Max Health. Each kill validates your method. Stronger, more confident, more lethal.

gh_ph3ba.title: Sprint Killer
gh_ph3ba.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Close the gap in a heartbeat. They hear footsteps and then nothing else  -  ever.

gh_ph3bb.title: Apex Phantom
gh_ph3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.01 Movement Speed. Top of the shadow food chain. Nothing outruns or outlasts you.

gh_sk1.title: Silent Kill
gh_sk1.description: +2 Attack Damage. One strike from the shadows. They never hear you, never see you, never rise again.

gh_sk2a.title: Throat Cutter
gh_sk2a.description: +3 Attack Damage. Aim for the spine. Even the undead need a nervous system  -  sever it.

gh_sk2b.title: Ambush Predator
gh_sk2b.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Patience, then explosion. You strike like a coiled spring releasing.

gh_sk3aa.title: Decapitator
gh_sk3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. One perfect arc. The head tumbles before the body knows it's dead  -  again.

gh_sk3ab.title: Vital Strike
gh_sk3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.005 Movement Speed. Target the critical point, close the distance instantly, end it.

gh_sk3ba.title: Rapid Execution
gh_sk3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Kill, move, kill, move. A rhythm of silent death that clears rooms in seconds.

gh_sk3bb.title: Reaper's Tempo
gh_sk3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Death has a rhythm and you've mastered its beat. Swing, kill, repeat.

gh_sm1.title: Smoke Screen
gh_sm1.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Vanish into the haze. When they can't see you, they can't touch you.

gh_sm2a.title: Fog of War
gh_sm2a.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. You move within a personal shroud. The dead grasp blindly and find nothing.

gh_sm2b.title: Choking Cloud
gh_sm2b.description: +0.1 Knockback Resistance, +1 Attack Damage. Strike from within the haze. They choke while you cut.

gh_sm3aa.title: Total Concealment
gh_sm3aa.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Invisible to all senses. You're a void in their perception  -  untargetable.

gh_sm3ab.title: Smoke Dancer
gh_sm3ab.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +0.01 Movement Speed. Dance through the smoke trail you leave behind. Graceful annihilation.

gh_sm3ba.title: Poison Fog
gh_sm3ba.description: +2 Attack Damage. Your smoke carries death. Breathe it in, fall down, stay down.

gh_sm3bb.title: Noxious Shroud
gh_sm3bb.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. A walking cloud of lethality. Everything near you wilts and dies.

gh_ss1.title: Shadow Sprint
gh_ss1.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. You learned to run in silence  -  bare feet on broken glass without a sound.

gh_ss2a.title: Midnight Dash
gh_ss2a.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Darkness is your highway. You blur between shadows like smoke on the wind.

gh_ss2b.title: Quicksilver Step
gh_ss2b.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +0.3 Attack Speed. Fast feet feed fast hands. Strike before they know you're there.

gh_ss3aa.title: Phantom Velocity
gh_ss3aa.description: +0.025 Movement Speed. You move so fast the infected can't track you. A ghost on the wind.

gh_ss3ab.title: Blur
gh_ss3ab.description: +0.018 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Speed is survival. You outrun death itself, and it keeps you alive.

gh_ss3ba.title: Razor Wind
gh_ss3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed. Your blade moves with your momentum  -  a cutting gale that shreds the dead.
